lesson_sections.title: Grammar: To be (am / is / are)
lesson_sections.content:
Ingliz tilida shaxs haqida ma'lumot berishda "to be" fe'lidan foydalaniladi:
- I am (Men ...) -> I am Anvar. I am 12 years old.
- He / She / It is -> She is from Tashkent. He is a student.
- We / You / They are -> We are in the 6th grade. They are friendly.

Inkor shakli (Negative):
- I am not a teacher.
- He is not (isn't) from Samarkand.

Savol shakli (Question):
- Are you 12 years old? - Yes, I am. / No, I'm not.
- Is she your classmate? - Yes, she is.

lesson_sections.title: Examples and Dialogues
lesson_sections.content:
A: Hello! What is your name?
B: Hi! My name is Malika.
A: How old are you?
B: I am 11 years old and I study in the 6th grade.
A: Where are you from?
B: I am from Uzbekistan, Bukhara. Nice to meet you!
A: Nice to meet you too!

lesson_sections.title: Grammar: Have got / Has got
lesson_sections.content:
"Have got / Has got" - "egalik qilmoq / bor bo'lmoq" ma'nosini bildiradi.

Darak shakli (Positive):
- I / You / We / They + have got (I've got a brother).
- He / She / It + has got (She's got a big family).

Inkor shakli (Negative):
- haven't got / hasn't got (We haven't got a pet).

Savol shakli (Question):
- Have you got any sisters? - Yes, I have. / No, I haven't.
- Has he got a dog? - Yes, he has.

lesson_sections.title: Daily Actions & Telling Time
lesson_sections.content:
Kun tartibi iboralari:
- wake up (uyg'onmoq)
- brush teeth (tish yuvmoq)
- have breakfast (nonushta qilmoq)
- go to school (maktabga bormoq)
- do homework (uy vazifasi bajarmoq)
- go to bed (uxlashga yotmoq)

Vaqtni aytish (Telling the time):
- It's 7 o'clock. (Soat yetti).
- It's half past seven. (Yetti yarim).
- It's quarter past eight. (Sakkizdan 15 daqiqa o'tdi).

lesson_sections.title: Grammar: Present Simple (Hozirgi oddiy zamon)
lesson_sections.content:
Present Simple doimiy takrorlanadigan odatlar, haqiqatlar va kun tartibi uchun ishlatiladi.

1. Positive (Darak):
- I / You / We / They + Verb (I play football. You play football.)
- He / She / It + Verb + (s/es) (He plays football. She watches TV.)

2. Negative (Inkor):
- I / You / We / They + don't + Verb (I don't play tennis.)
- He / She / It + doesn't + Verb (He doesn't play tennis.)

3. Question (Savol):
- Do you play football? - Yes, I do. / No, I don't.
- Does he play football? - Yes, he does. / No, he doesn't.

Qoidalar: Fe'l -ch, -sh, -ss, -x, -o bilan tugasa: watches, washes, goes, mixes qo'shiladi.

lesson_sections.title: Grammar: Present Continuous (Hozirgi davomli zamon)
lesson_sections.content:
Ayni paytda (hozir) bo'layotgan ish-harakatlar uchun ishlatiladi.

Formula: Subject + am/is/are + Verb-ing

1. Positive:
- I am reading a book now.
- He is doing his homework at the moment.
- They are playing in the school yard.

2. Negative:
- I am not sleeping.
- She isn't watching TV.
- We aren't making noise.

3. Question:
- Are you listening to music? - Yes, I am.
- Is she writing a letter? - No, she isn't.

Signal so'zlar: now, at the moment, right now, Look!, Listen!

lesson_sections.title: Grammar: Countable & Uncountable Nouns, Some / Any
lesson_sections.content:
Sanaladigan otlar (Countable): apple, banana, egg, sandwich (an apple, two apples).
Sanalmaydigan otlar (Uncountable): water, milk, rice, bread, cheese, sugar.

Some va Any:
- Some: Darak gaplarda (I have some apples. I want some water.)
- Any: Inkor va savol gaplarda (There isn't any milk. Do you have any bread?)

lesson_sections.title: Grammar: Can / Can't (Qobiliyat va imkoniyat)
lesson_sections.content:
Can fe'li qobiliyatni ("qo'lidan kelmoq / qila olmoq") ifodalaydi.
- I can swim very fast.
- She can play the piano.
- They can't (cannot) speak German.
- Can you ride a bicycle? - Yes, I can. / No, I can't.

lesson_sections.title: School Subjects & Prepositions of Time (at, in, on)
lesson_sections.content:
Maktab fanlari: Mathematics (Maths), English, History, Science, Art, PE (Physical Education), Music, Geography.

Vaqt predloglari:
- AT: soat vaqtlarida (at 8:00, at noon, at night)
- ON: kunlar va sanalarda (on Monday, on Friday morning, on May 9th)
- IN: oylar, yillar va kun qismlarida (in September, in 2026, in the morning)

lesson_sections.title: Grammar: There is / There are
lesson_sections.content:
Biror joyda biror narsa borligini aytish:
- There is + birlik ot: There is a sofa in the living room.
- There are + ko'plik ot: There are three chairs in the kitchen.

Inkor:
- There isn't a TV in my bedroom.
- There aren't any books on the desk.

Savol:
- Is there a mirror in the hall? - Yes, there is.
- Are there two windows? - No, there aren't.

lesson_sections.title: Weather & Comparative Adjectives
lesson_sections.content:
Ob-havo: sunny (quyoshli), rainy (yomg'irli), snowy (qorli), windy (shamolli), cloudy (bulutli), hot (issiq), cold (sovuq).

Sifat darajalari (Comparatives - Qiyosiy daraja):
- Qisqa sifatlar + er + than:
  cold -> colder than (Summer is hotter than spring).
  fast -> faster than
- Uzun sifatlar: more + sifat + than:
  beautiful -> more beautiful than
  comfortable -> more comfortable than

lesson_sections.title: Transport & Prepositions of Movement
lesson_sections.content:
Transport turlari bilan "by" predlogi:
- by bus, by train, by car, by plane (lekin: on foot - piyoda).

Harakat predloglari:
- to: I go to Samarkand by train.
- through: The train goes through the tunnel.
- across: We walked across the bridge.

lesson_sections.title: Grammar: Past Simple (Was / Were & Regular Verbs)
lesson_sections.content:
O'tgan zamon (Past Simple) o'tmishda yakunlangan harakatlar uchun ishlatiladi.

1. To be o'tgan zamonda:
- I / He / She / It WAS (I was at home yesterday).
- We / You / They WERE (They were in the park).

2. To'g'ri fe'llar (Regular verbs) + ed:
- play -> played (We played football on Sunday).
- visit -> visited (She visited her grandmother).
- watch -> watched (I watched a cartoon).

Signal so'zlar: yesterday, last week, two days ago, in 2025.

exercises.question: Choose the correct form: "I ___ a student in the 6th grade."
exercises.explanation: "I" olmoshidan keyin to be fe'lining "am" shakli ishlatiladi.

exercises.question: True or False: "She are from Uzbekistan" is grammatically correct.
exercises.explanation: "She" birlik shaxs bo'lgani uchun "is" ishlatilishi kerak: "She is from Uzbekistan".

exercises.question: He ___ two sisters and one brother.
He ___ to school every day by bus.
exercises.explanation: "He" uchinchi shaxs birlik bo‘lgani uchun Present Simple’da "go" fe’liga "-es" qo‘shilib "goes" bo‘ladi.

exercises.question: ___ you speak English fluently?
exercises.explanation: Present Simple so‘roq gaplarida "you" olmoshi uchun "Do" yordamchi fe’li ishlatiladi.

exercises.question: Look! The boys ___ football in the garden right now.
exercises.explanation: "Look!" va "right now" davomli zamon signali bo‘lib, ko‘plikdagi the boys uchun "are playing" to‘g‘ri.

exercises.question: There isn't ___ milk in the fridge.
exercises.explanation: Inkor gaplarda sanalmaydigan va ko‘plikdagi otlar bilan "any" ishlatiladi.

exercises.question: There ___ four chairs around the dining table.
exercises.explanation: Ko‘plikdagi otlar (four chairs) uchun "There are" ishlatiladi.

exercises.question: Summer is ___ than winter.
exercises.explanation: Qisqa sifat "hot" qiyosiy darajada oxirgi undoshi ikkilanib "hotter than" bo‘ladi.

exercises.question: We ___ our grandparents in Bukhara last weekend.
exercises.explanation: "last weekend" o‘tgan zamon bo‘lgani sababli to‘g‘ri fe’l "visit"ga "-ed" qo‘shiladi: "visited".

test_questions.question: Where ___ you from? - I am from Tashkent.
test_questions.explanation: "You" olmoshi bilan "are" to be shakli keladi.

test_questions.question: She ___ got two cats and a puppy.
test_questions.explanation: Uchinchi shaxs birlikda "has got" ishlatiladi.

test_questions.question: What time is it? "It is half past eight."
test_questions.explanation: "half past eight" sakkiz yarim degan ma'noni beradi (8:30).

test_questions.question: I usually brush my ___ after breakfast.
test_questions.explanation: "brush teeth" - tishlarni yuvmoq iborasi.

test_questions.question: They ___ in the classroom now; they are in the gym.
test_questions.explanation: Inkor shakl: "They aren't in the classroom".

test_questions.question: Shakhlo ___ television every evening.
test_questions.explanation: Doimiy odat (every evening) uchun Present Simple ishlatiladi: watches.

test_questions.question: Listen! Someone ___ the piano beautifully.
test_questions.explanation: "Listen!" ayni damda ro‘y berayotganini bildiradi: is playing.

test_questions.question: My brother ___ like mushrooms in soup.
test_questions.explanation: Uchinchi shaxs inkorida "doesn't like" ishlatiladi.

test_questions.question: What ___ at the moment? - I am doing my homework.
test_questions.explanation: "at the moment" so‘rog‘i: What are you doing?

test_questions.question: Water ___ at 100 degrees Celsius.
test_questions.explanation: Tabiat qonuni va doimiy haqiqat uchun Present Simple: boils.

test_questions.question: Can I have ___ water, please?
test_questions.explanation: Iltimos yoki taklif mazmunidagi savollarda "some" ishlatiladi.

test_questions.question: ___ there any books on the shelf?
test_questions.explanation: "books" ko‘plikda bo‘lgani uchun "Are there" ishlatiladi.

test_questions.question: We have History lessons ___ Tuesdays and Thursdays.
test_questions.explanation: Hafta kunlari bilan "on" predlogi ishlatiladi.

test_questions.question: Which of the following is UNCOUNTABLE?
test_questions.explanation: "Bread" (non) sanalmaydigan ot hisoblanadi.

test_questions.question: She ___ play tennis very well, she is the school champion.
test_questions.explanation: Qobiliyat ifodalash uchun "can" ishlatiladi.

test_questions.question: Where ___ you yesterday at 5 o'clock?
test_questions.explanation: O'tgan zamonda "you" bilan "were" ishlatiladi.

test_questions.question: We traveled from Tashkent to Samarkand ___ fast train.
test_questions.explanation: Transport vositasi bilan "by" predlogi ishlatiladi: by train.

test_questions.question: They ___ football because it was raining heavily.
test_questions.explanation: Past Simple inkorida: "didn't play".

test_questions.question: Anvar ___ his project two days ago.
test_questions.explanation: "two days ago" o‘tgan zamon belgisi: finished.

test_questions.question: Did you ___ to the museum last Friday? - Yes, I did.
test_questions.explanation: So‘roq shaklida "Did"dan so‘ng fe’lning asl shakli (go) keladi.

test_questions.question: Which sentence is grammatically correct?
test_questions.explanation: "He doesn't like cold weather" to‘g‘ri Present Simple inkor strukturasi.

test_questions.question: A cheetah is ___ than a horse.
test_questions.explanation: Sifatning qiyosiy darajasi: faster than.

test_questions.question: Look at those dark clouds! It ___ rain.
test_questions.explanation: Dalil ko‘rinib turgan yaqin kelajak: is going to rain.

test_questions.question: English is spoken ___ many people around the world.
test_questions.explanation: Vosita/bajaruvchi predlogi: by.

test_questions.question: ___ you ever been to the Charvak lake?
test_questions.explanation: Savol: "Have you ever been...?"
